name: SilentMessageToggle
description: Adds a button to the chat bar to toggle sending a silent message.
summary: Chat-bar toggle for sending silent messages

settings.label: Persist state
settings.description: How to persist the silent message toggle state

settings.label: Auto-disable
settings.description: Automatically disable the silent message toggle again after sending one

notes: "Persist between channels and restarts" saves the toggle and restores it after a restart; upstream instead starts every channel with the toggle on in that mode. Qord's send path turns the @silent prefix into a silent message the way Discord's client does.
